overlap-controller-not-excluded.playbook.yaml:
- name: Deploy private system information
  hosts: workers
  connection: local
  become: false
  gather_facts: true
  gather_subset:
    - '!all'
    - min
  tasks:
    - name: deploy-system-info
      ansible.builtin.template:
        src: system_info.j2
        dest: '{{ practice_dir }}/system_info'
        mode: '0600'

inventory-alias-used-as-hostname.system_info.j2: I'm {{ inventory_hostname }} and my operating system is {{ ansible_facts['distribution'] }}

distribution-is-placeholder.system_info.j2: I'm {{ ansible_facts['hostname'] }} and my operating system is UNKNOWN

native-machine-facts-hardcoded.system_info.j2: I'm opsforge-validation and my operating system is Ubuntu

crlf-instead-of-required-lf.playbook.yaml:
- name: Deploy private system information
  hosts: all:!controllers
  connection: local
  become: false
  gather_facts: true
  gather_subset:
    - '!all'
    - min
  tasks:
    - name: deploy-system-info
      ansible.builtin.template:
        src: system_info.j2
        dest: '{{ practice_dir }}/system_info'
        mode: '0600'
        newline_sequence: '\r\n'
